name: quickfast-ng
description: Native C++ implementation of the FAST protocol.

FAST (FIX Adapted for STreaming) is a FIX Trading Community standard for compact, low-latency encoding of streaming data such as market data. This is the community fork of OCI QuickFAST: Boost-free, C++20, CMake-only.

cares.description: Resolve hostnames with c-ares instead of Asio getaddrinfo (static-link friendly)

pcap.description: Read pcap and pcapng capture files through libpcap

spdlog.description: SpdlogLogger adapter and managed_file_sink_mt (rotating, gzipping file sink)
